label: copy phase: input i or j while outputting j (the i->j bigram)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>). It fires when the fed-back input is i or j and the token being recalled is j, i.e. when the copy is reproducing an original i j or j j bigram. The strongest activations are on input i with output j (precision 0.92 alone, ~70% of mass); top examples look like ...i j j..., with a weaker follow-up activation on the next j->j step. Activations on j->j are weaker and less reliable (precision ~0.46). A smaller residual fires weakly on input i with output i or another letter (for example i i, i h; 0.01-0.2 of max). It is silent on other input tokens and on the first occurrence of a token. Rates are highest at recall_idx 2-3. Dev: F1 0.73, mass recall 0.90; adding a recall-position limit helps only slightly.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=i (+8.78), phase=2 & in_tok=j (+6.12), phase=2 & out_tok=j (+5.31), next_out=j (+4.71), out_tok=j (+4.67), in_tok=i (+4.39). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-2.26), in_first=0 (-1.88), next_out=w (-1.69), next_out=l (-1.56).
